title: Frontend/backend interaction trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for frontend-backend-interaction trace events.

app.description: The browser side: what is on screen and what the JavaScript is holding.

status.description: Technical code for the render state; the visualizer localizes it.

items.description: Rows the component is currently rendering, as the frontend parsed them.

token.description: The token the frontend stores and re-attaches to every call; null when signed out.

error.description: Technical code for what went wrong: no answer at all, or an error status.

errorDetail.description: The status code behind an `http` error; empty otherwise.

socket.description: Whether a WebSocket connection is open, i.e. whether the server may speak first.

lastPush.description: The last message the server sent on its own initiative.

api.description: The server side: the routing table, the stored data, and the per-user memory it does not keep.

sessions.description: Sessions stored on the server — always 0, which is what stateless means.

routes.description: The routing table, as method + path templates.

matchedRoute.description: The route the current request was mapped onto; null when nothing matched.

network.description: Whether the wire between the two sides currently works.

request.description: The message the frontend wrote (absent before the first call).

body.description: Body fields in the order the client wrote them.

response.description: The message that came back; absent when nothing came back at all.

kind.description: Technical code for the outcome, so the visualizer can colour it.

body.description: The response body as the text it really is.

failure.description: Why the call ended without a response: never delivered, or delivered with the answer lost.

payload.description: The serialization boundary of the last inspected record, field by field.

java.description: The Java type on the server.

json.description: What JSON can express it as.

note.description: Technical code for the trap in this conversion; empty when there is none.

stats.description: Running totals across the whole run.

failed.description: Calls that ended without a response.

duplicates.description: Records created twice by a retry.

polls.description: Round trips spent asking for news that was not there.

pushes.description: Messages the server sent without being asked.
